lore: {name} grows only where a bud was planted outside the End: in the End itself the buds give nothing but stick trees. Ashwood is the paler one, Duskwood a little browner.
use: Works like any Vanilla wood: logs give four planks, an axe strips logs, and every block burns as fuel. Dropped into the void it floats back up and waits just above the bottom of the world.
secret: A dropped piece of End wood lies around for ten minutes instead of five - the End is a long way to walk back.

lore: {name} is the seed of the End woods, a closed chorus-like blossom on a knobby stem.
use: Plant it on End stone or dirt. Outside the End, in light level 9 or more, it grows a gigantic tree; in the dark bone meal gives stick scrub. In the End it always grows a tree of End sticks.
secret: Four buds of the same wood in a 2x2 square grow a still bigger tree - and sixteen in a 4x4 square the biggest tree in the game. A tree gives back fewer buds than it took.

lore: {name} is the wood of the End: its trees are bundles of sticks with a trunk, branches and a crown.
use: Cut the trunk of a stick tree and everything above falls at once, like chorus. Placed sticks never fall; upright they taper like dripstone. One block crafts into three sticks.

lore: {name} is no solid block but a see-through star of tendrils around a small crystal, tinted grey-brown by its biome.
use: Only a few leaves of each tree carry its bud or fruit, and they always drop it; the rest gives sticks now and then. Shears keep the leaves.

lore: A light, pale fruit that only ripens on the stick trees of the End. It seems to want to float away.
use: Eating it gives four seconds of Slow Falling and a small hop - enough to glide from one End island to the next ledge.
secret: It is always edible, even with a full hunger bar.

lore: Wiry grass that grows on End stone, tinted grey-brown like the leaves around it.
use: Shears pick it up. Bone meal spreads a few tufts onto neighboring End stone.

lore: A dry, twiggy bush of the outer End islands.
use: Shears pick it up; otherwise it drops a few sticks.

lore: Nibblemites live in small groups in Ash Valley and the Dawnlands and wear the colors of their biome.
use: They nibble End stone like sheep graze; the stone recovers by itself. Chorus fruit tempts and breeds them.
secret: Endermen ignore them - a Nibblemite is no Endermite.

lore: End stone with a Nibblemite's tracks on top.
use: Mines and drops like End stone; left alone it turns back into End stone after a few minutes.

lore: A Drift Fruit that grew outside the End: shrivelled, brown and a little mouldy.
use: Eating it lets you drift for five seconds - almost weightless, pushed about by nothing at all. Slow Falling afterwards makes sure you land softly.
secret: End fruit only ripens in the End; plant your buds there if you want the real thing.
